description:
Xebia is a global AI-first, digital transformation, and engineering partner. With over 25 years of experience and a team of 5,000 professionals across 16 countries, we help organizations design and build scalable products, platforms, and data-driven solutions. 

We specialize in Artificial Intelligence, Data and Cloud, Intelligent Automation, and Digital Products, combining deep technical expertise with a strong focus on engineering excellence and a people-first culture.  

In the CEE region, we’re a team of nearly 1,000 experts delivering modern applications, data platforms, and AI solutions for clients such as Millennium, ING, Play, Edenred, Arabian Drilling, FedEx, Leroy Merlin, Truecaller, Volotea, Schmitz Cargobull, and many, many more. We work with leading technologies including AWS, Azure, GCP, Databricks, and Snowflake, and combine strong engineering culture with a consulting mindset and a continuous focus on growth and knowledge sharing. 

 

You will:

  • investigate active and historical fraud attacks targeting OTP and phone-number verification flows;

  • analyse fraud patterns across countries, carriers, phone number ranges, devices and attestation signals;

  • identify and distinguish SMS pumping, bot traffic, account abuse and legitimate traffic spikes;

  • quantify fraud volume, financial impact and the effect of attacks on legitimate users;

  • analyse and backtest anti-fraud rules and thresholds, balancing fraud prevention against false positives;

  • recommend evidence-based improvements to fraud detection rules and thresholds;

  • build scheduled queries, monitoring dashboards and alerts to detect suspicious activity early;

  • collaborate with backend engineers, providing clear and actionable rule proposals ready for implementation;

  • document investigation processes, create fraud detection playbooks and transfer knowledge to the internal analytics team.

Your profile:

  • 5+ years of experience in analytics engineering, data science or fraud analytics, including at least 2 years of hands-on experience in fraud or abuse detection;

  • expert-level SQL skills, particularly with BigQuery, including large event tables, window functions and cost-efficient queries;

  • strong Python skills, especially pandas and Jupyter notebooks, for data analysis and fraud investigations;

  • experience building scheduled data pipelines using Airflow and dashboards using Looker or equivalent BI tools;

  • practical experience tuning rule-based fraud detection systems, including backtesting and false-positive analysis;

  • ability to work independently, investigate complex problems and translate findings into actionable recommendations;

  • strong communication skills, with the ability to present technical findings clearly to both engineers and business stakeholders;

  • Work from the European Union region and a work permit are required.


Nice to have:

  • experience investigating telecom or SMS fraud, particularly SMS pumping, artificially inflated traffic or IRSF;

  • hands-on experience with CPaaS provider logs and billing data, such as Vonage, Twilio, Sinch or Infobip;

  • knowledge of identity verification systems, OTP funnels, rate limiting, velocity rules and device attestation (Play Integrity, App Attest);

  • experience investigating fraud patterns in emerging markets, particularly Africa and South Asia;

  • familiarity with event streaming technologies such as Kafka and streaming anomaly detection using Dataflow or Flink;

  • experience with statistical anomaly detection or lightweight machine learning approaches, such as BigQuery ML or isolation forests.

 

 

Recruitment Process:

CV review – HR call – Interview – Client Interview – Decision
